EC2: Women who are known to be pregnant.
EC3: Any patient who has been previously randomized in the EvK Trial.
EC4: Patients who require endotracheal intubation [AND] [NOT] without sedative medication. For example, patients in full cardiac arrest.
EC5: Patients with a known allergy to ketamine [OR] or etomidate.
EC6: Any individual wearing a MedAlert bracelet indicating that he/she has formally opted out of the EvK Trial.
